steps.note: It is then dried for several days.
Shaped into bars or hand-sized balls, each with an elderflower panicle stuck in so the mites can get inside.
The cheeses sit one to twelve months in a box with the mites and rye flour, which feeds them and keeps them from eating too much cheese.

sources.text: The steps from drained quark to mite-ripened Milbenkäse and the one to twelve months of ripening; the source gives no temperature or humidity.
